messages:
anya: Quick sync — embeddings endpoint prioritization. Customer A pushed for 4096 dims + large-batch uploads for vector DB import. They said they'd pay for dedicated capacity but want a public API path for the MVP. What's the minimal scope to ship safely?

luke: TL;DR: ship 1536 dims public, 4096 via Dedicated preview. 4096 needs quant or multi-GPU sharding to keep latency sane. For public hosted we should cap per-request items to avoid OOMs.

maria: +1. From embed quality evals, 1536 hits 95% of use cases; 4096 gives marginal recall improvements for specific customers. We should run customer-specific eval sets before enabling 4k.

ravi: Ops constraints: large batches (10k vectors) are the real risk. If we allow >2k items per request we need to reserve memory and increase request-timeouts. Suggest policy: public max_items=2k, dedicated configurable up to 10k with tenant quotas. Also require per-tenant concurrent_requests limit.

jamal: API surface decision: keep single /embeddings endpoint, add query param dim=1536|4096 and optional header x-dedicated-tenant. Avoid new endpoints. For response format keep single array of floats for now: {"data": [{"embedding": [..], "index": 0}], "model": "rwd-embed-1536"}.

anya: Launch criteria proposal: (1) public hosted: 1536 dim, max_items=2k, latency p95 < 150ms for 1-item, documented pricing; (2) Dedicated preview: 4096 opt-in, quota controls, SLA; (3) Evals: embedding similarity/regression tests signed off by ML. Also must add clear migration notes for customers.

luke: Implementation notes: for 4096 mode we enable int8 quant in the runtime and increase KV cache allocation. Need a kernel path that handles 4k sequences more efficiently. Might take 3 sprints if we factor in canarying.

maria: Customer eval ask: provide synthetic dataset + small harness so Customer A can run their tests in our staging. We should also run a recall vs latency curve for both dims.

ravi: Billing/limits: recommend tiered pricing: standard per-embedding token unit for 1536 and a multiplier for 4096 when hosted via Dedicated. For public 4k (if we ever enable) charge a premium. Also add API-level headers that return quota usage.

anya: UX docs action: create migration guide + sample payloads (bulk CSV import example with chunking advice). Also include example of handling 429 and backoff.

jamal: One technical question: do we support mixed-dimension batches (some items 1536, some 4096) in the same request? My vote: disallow mixing; require homogeneous batch or return 400 with clear message. Simpler for runtime.

luke: Agree with disallowing mixed dims. If customer needs hetero, they can send two requests or use Dedicated where we can do more complex routing.

anya: Next steps: Luke + Maria to scope perf work and estimate sprints; Ravi to draft quota/limit policy and storage implications; Jamal to produce API payload examples and error codes; I'll coordinate customer communication and landing page copy. Can we aim for a beta in 6 weeks? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: I'll start the eval runs tomorrow and post results in #eng-ml.

ravi: I'll draft the quota doc and put initial numbers in the shared doc (link in thread).

deploy-bot: New deploy scheduled: staging/runtime/embeddings/qual-stage at 2026-03-30T02:00Z :rocket:

anya: Thanks all — follow-ups on the doc. :thumbsup:
